title: unified-rollouts-weighted-canary-shadow-autorollback-safety-guards
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds weighted canary rollout mode with optional shadow traffic sampling and metric-driven auto-rollback safety guards. Improves observability and adds e2e tests and migration docs.
description:
Motivation: production rollouts need flexible traffic controls (weighted canary, A/B, shadow), robust metric-driven automatic rollback, and safety guards to avoid cascading failures. This PR implements a weighted-canary mode in the unified rollouts controller, introduces an optional shadow traffic sampler that sends copies of requests to candidate models without impacting production QPS, and extends the auto-rollback engine with multi-metric thresholds and cooldown windows.

What this PR does: checklist:
- [x] Add weighted canary controller support (percent by route + model variant mapping)
- [x] Shadow traffic sampler with configurable sample rate and header propagation
- [x] Metric-driven auto-rollback improvements: multi-metric matching, per-rollout cooldown, and recovery cooldown windows
- [x] Safety guards: global circuit-breaker integration, max-failure-rate ceiling, and sequential-stage verification
- [x] Observability: rollout-level metrics, detailed rollback reasons, and per-variant latency histograms
- [x] E2E and unit tests for new behaviors; stability tests for shadow sampler
- [x] Docs: rollout guide, migration notes, and operator checklist

Implementation notes: The rollout controller now supports 'weighted' strategy in addition to 'canary' and 'shadow'. We model weights as integer percentages with automatic normalization and an optional ramp schedule. Shadow sampler is implemented as a request interposer that duplicates request payloads to a background queue; only metadata and outputs are recorded in the candidate model trace to avoid PII leakage. The auto-rollback engine was refactored to evaluate an ordered list of metrics (latency_p95, error_rate, quality_regression_score) with per-metric thresholds and an aggregate decision policy (fail-on-majority | fail-on-any depending on rollout profile). Cooldown windows prevent oscillation between variants.

Backwards compatibility: config fields are additive; existing rollout specs continue to behave the same. Operators can opt-in to weighted rollouts and shadow sampling. Migration guide included in docs/rollouts/migration-weighted.md.

Rollout plan: merge to main, enable feature flag rollout.weighted_by_default=false, staged rollout to canary cluster for 48 hours, then enable for 10% of accounts, monitor metrics, promote gradually.

Notes on security: shadow sampler redacts user-identifying fields by default and integrates with KMS-based logging hooks.

References: ENG-1982 (weighted rollouts), ENG-2010 (auto-rollback improvements).

review_comments: Evan Chen (2026-02-22): Can we make the shadow sampler non-blocking at the HTTP layer? We shouldn't add tail latency to production requests.
Aisha Patel (2026-02-22): Shadow sampler is async; we enqueue a copy and attach a non-blocking header. Updated implementation to use bounded background queue and backpressure metrics.
Lucia Moreno (2026-02-23): The multi-metric decision policy is powerful but risky. Suggest adding a strict-mode flag that fails on any metric exceeding threshold for critical routes.
Aisha Patel (2026-02-24): Added 'strictMode' option per-rollout and documented recommended defaults for high-SLO routes.
Tomás Rivera (2026-02-25): E2E test flakes on CI (rollout_canary_smoke). Repro locally: 1 in 50 runs. Investigating timing assumptions in test harness.
Aisha Patel (2026-02-26): Fixed test harness timing and added stability guard. Marked test as deterministic and added retries in the CI job definition.
Evan Chen (2026-02-27): lgtm after test fixes and docs updates. Approving.
Lucia Moreno (2026-02-27): Approving with suggestion to add an alert playbook — added to docs as playbooks/rollouts.md.
notes_on_incidents: No incidents triggered during rollout. Canary cluster saw a transient spike in p95 which triggered a targeted rollback in a staged test; controlled by cooldown logic and did not impact main production cluster.
operator_instructions: To enable weighted rollouts: update rollout spec strategy.type=weighted and set weights in rollout.spec.strategy.weights. To enable shadow sampling: set rollout.spec.shadow.sample_rate and ensure shadow.target is configured. See docs/rollouts/migration-weighted.md for migration steps and playbooks/rollouts.md for runbook.
changelog_entry: Feature: Weighted canary rollouts + shadow sampling + multi-metric auto-rollback with safety guards (operators can opt-in).
test_summary: Added 12 unit tests, 3 integration tests, and 4 new e2e scenarios covering weighted ramping, shadow sampling validation, and auto-rollback triggers. CI initially surfaced a flaky e2e which was stabilized before merge.
